ideas.pitch: A real-time telemetry and impact force visualization system for combat robots using edge sensors and wireless mesh transmission.
ideas.title: Arena Telemetry and Impact Diagnostics HUD
ideas.why_it_could_win: Robowars judges evaluate based on damage, aggression, and strategy; providing hard quantitative impact data directly addresses their judging criteria.

ideas.pitch: An independent hardware safety overlay that ensures compliance with strict wireless deactivation regulations and detects internal armor structural failures.
ideas.title: FailSafe-Link: Autonomous Wireless Kill Switch and Armor Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Safety inspections are mandatory and strict at Robowars; a dedicated hardware safety system directly solves tournament clearance bottlenecks.

ideas.pitch: An edge-processed computer vision overlay that helps operators track opponents inside fast-paced arena matches.
ideas.title: CombatBot Vision: Autonomous Target Tracking Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced tactical control, matching the judging criteria for combat effectiveness and strategic driving.

ideas.pitch: An embedded diagnostic tool for pneumatically-actuated weapon systems to monitor tank pressures and prevent mid-match failures.
ideas.title: Pneumatic Pressure Optimizer and Leak Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Pneumatic weapon systems are prone to failure; this provides a robust engineering solution that impresses judges looking for hard mechanics.

ideas.pitch: A reinforcement reconnaissance bot designed to inspect arena flooring conditions and debris hazards before full robot deployment.
ideas.title: Arena Obstacle and Damage Mapping Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an unusual physical hardware build with a live working demo that stands out in a room full of standard software pitches.
